feature_contract.goal: Preserve the complete main-menu and vehicle-selector artwork's intended source aspect and all four transformed quad corners through 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, portrait and stale-size DX9Ex reset transitions without clipping the visual content.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only eligible contained original title/front-end and vehicle-selection custom sprite quads receive the live physical viewport cap and single affine. Preserve Vanilla anisotropic X, unrelated HUD, GOAL/+TIME, input and FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original main menu and vehicle-selector D3DX-authored sprite corners are transformed into four source-space top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right vertices by the UIScaling producer.
The custom quad containment mapping used cached screen_scale, which can lag the live screen dimensions across D3D9Ex Reset and previously risked oversized vertices or asymmetric corner transforms.

Live viewport-constrained OutRunVrMenuQuad::BuildPixelMap produces a single bounded uniform affine shared by all four corners before the unchanged game D3D9 sprite draw and R84 per-eye host composition.
subcomponents: Cap both cached X and Y source scales against current physical viewport and source extents, reject nonfinite/invalid geometry, and map all four custom quad corners with one coherent X/Y affine in the real game UIScaling source.

Build and execute native host-side C++ regression of the real source header for aspect-ratio, portrait, stale-size Reset, smaller authored scale, Vanilla desktop anisotropic and invalid/negative geometry without changing protected stereo or original input paths.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Main menu and vehicle-select original sprite-to-screen geometry
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: At 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, portrait and stale-size Reset, all four source quad corners retain one centered uniform affine bounded by the actual new viewport with complete car-selection art.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Vanilla and negative invalid-size input plus unrelated effects
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Original uncontained Vanilla anisotropic X and native sprite behavior stay intact; invalid or nonfinite containment dimensions fail closed without touching FFB, SkyGlow, HUD, GOAL or R26_SAFE.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Native C++ smoke, Windows R84 game, R26 safe fallback, x64 host and CI package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The final validation-bearing exact SHA must execute custom quad native smoke and pass DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/package, Domain Isolation and affected Full Source/HUD workflows; HMD is separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original UIScaling custom sprite quad emits four transformed D3DX corners and consumes game screen_scale, while live D3D9Ex Reset can change physical output dimensions ahead of that cached value.
source_trace: Original D3DX sprite dimensions and source corner transforms are read in src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp at the game's custom quad producer.
src/vr/ui/menu_quad_transform.hpp computes a live physical viewport cap from screen extent divided by source extent, then returns one centered bounded PixelMap for four X/Y vertices.
R84 independent mainline game uses the original sprite draw with identical 4-corner geometry; x64 host native smoke exercises the same game header before OpenXR eye presentation.
diagnosis.root_cause: Cached screen_scale can reflect the old backbuffer after Reset even while the new output extent is smaller, causing overflowing/cropped menu and vehicle-select quads when placement relies only on stale game scale.
alternatives_rejected: Do not stretch only the X axis, patch individual quad vertices independently, or change global HUD/screen-space scaling, since these would skew artwork or regress accepted desktop and scene geometry.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material C++ result c53a28e adds physical viewport cap and one affine across all four corners, with native executable smoke in mandatory x64 host dependency.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: The native menu_custom_quad_smoke.cpp includes smaller intentional game scale, Vanilla anisotropic fallback, zero/NaN/tiny source dimensions, stale 1920-to-1600 output and arbitrary transformed corner deltas.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only original eligible contained 2D front-end sprite geometry is modified before existing R84 stereo/host; new code does not assert physical Quest3 binocular outcome.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: No game/Quest3/VDXR hardware test was executed; final optical and reset behavior remains untested.

next_action: Resolve missing feature record under the same material result, then run complete mandatory exact-SHA GitHub gates. Do not double-score; only the original C++ material implementation can count after verified validation.
